story.titleZh: 金·卡戴珊重燃与梅赛德斯车手安东内利的搞笑毛巾风波
story.summaryZh: 金·卡戴珊在新加坡大奖赛期间与梅赛德斯车手安东内利发生搞笑毛巾事件，并誓言不再触碰他的毛巾。
story.originalTitle: Kim Kardashian revives hilarious F1 towel drama with Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli
detailZh: 金·卡戴珊在新加坡大奖赛期间与梅赛德斯车手安东内利发生搞笑毛巾风波
金·卡戴珊誓言永远不会再次触碰梅赛德斯车手安东内利的毛巾，此前她在摩纳哥大奖赛期间不小心偷走了他的冷却毛巾
金·卡戴珊站在发车线上
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
一级方程式赛车场的看台是高调名人的巨大磁铁，但很少有A级名人的亮相能像金·卡戴珊与梅赛德斯-奔驰的安德烈亚·基米·安东内利之间的持续故事那样，引发如此多的搞笑病毒性争议。
在参加2026年新加坡大奖赛以支持法拉利车队的小汉密尔顿时，这位真人秀亿万富翁在新加坡航空的红毯上遇到了这位年轻的车手冠军，瞬间复活了本赛季最有趣的场外故事。
在即将到来的艰苦的滨海湾夜赛中，卡戴珊撞到了安东内利，她立刻提到了他们共同的病毒性历史。在朋友们的陪伴下，卡戴珊以防御性的、开玩笑的姿态举起双手，被听到告诉这位梅赛德斯车手，"不，基米，这次我可不敢碰你的毛巾了。"
这场搞笑的交流成为了被称为"毛巾门"的整个赛季友好看台玩笑的最新章节。
这个内部笑话可以追溯到六月初的摩纳哥大奖赛。在安东内利在蒙特卡洛街道上取得压倒性胜利后，正在访问公国以支持汉密尔顿的卡戴珊被相机捕捉到意外地拿走了梅赛德斯车手的官方颁奖台冷却毛巾。病毒式视频显示她天真地用获胜者的毛巾擦去额头和太阳镜，然后随意地带着毛巾离开。
意识到这是一个巨大的社交媒体机会，梅赛德斯数字团队和安东内利迅速发布了一段搞笑视频，展示了这位意大利青少年在摩纳哥维修区四处走动，询问包括乔治·拉塞尔在内的队友们是否看到了他丢失的毛巾。
几周后，卡戴珊证明她完全参与了这场玩笑。在巴塞罗那-加泰罗尼亚大奖赛之前，她正式弥补了错误，给安东内利送上一条全新的、定制的刺绣毛巾，引发了年轻梅赛德斯车手制作的备受瞩目的“感谢”视频。
虽然红毯互动都是笑容和玩笑，但新加坡大奖赛对卡戴珊的F1圈子中的车手们产生了截然不同的结果。
安东内利设法在极端高温、严重的轮胎磨损以及一场关于赛道的重大争议中幸存下来，艰难地赢得了第三名的领奖台，同时保持了他在车手总冠军中的巨大领先优势。与此同时，汉密尔顿——在马丁·布兰德利的赛前网格采访后，卡戴珊在法拉利维修区积极为他加油——在比赛后期犯下了策略错误，并因错过维修区入口而付出了高昂的代价，这使他排名大幅下降，最终以令人沮丧的第六名结束比赛。
随着安东内利在即将到来的美国大奖赛（在奥斯汀举行）中在数学上几乎可以锁定世界车手总冠军，人们仍然不知道卡戴珊是否会前往德克萨斯州，以确保这位年轻明星的车手总冠军毛巾安全无恙。
detailEn: Kim Kardashian revives hilarious F1 towel drama with Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli
Kim Kardashian vows never to touch Kimi Antonelli's towels again after she accidentally stole his cool-down towel in Monaco
Kim Kardashian on the grid.
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

The Formula 1 paddock is a massive magnet for high-profile celebrities, but few A-list appearances have generated as much hilarious viral drama as Kim Kardashian's ongoing saga with Mercedes' Andrea Kimi Antonelli.

While attending the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix to support Scuderia Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, the reality TV billionaire ran into the young championship leader on the Singapore Airlines red carpet, instantly reviving the funniest off-track storyline of the season.

As Kardashian bumped into Antonelli ahead of the gruelling Marina Bay night race, she immediately referenced their shared viral history. Throwing her hands up in a defensive, joking posture alongside friends, Kardashian was heard telling the Mercedes driver, "Nooo, Kimi, I don't dare to touch your towel this time."
The hilarious exchange serves as the latest chapter in a friendly, season-long paddock joke dubbed "Towel-Gate".

The inside joke dates back to the Monaco Grand Prix in early June. After Antonelli secured a dominant victory around the streets of Monte Carlo, Kardashian - who was visiting the Principality to support Hamilton - was caught on camera accidentally swiping the Mercedes driver's official podium cool-down towel. Viral footage showed her innocently using the race winner's towel to wipe her brow and sunglasses before casually walking away with it.

Recognising a massive social media opportunity, the Mercedes digital team and Antonelli quickly released a hilarious video of the Italian teenager wandering around the Monaco paddock asking team-mates, including George Russell, if they had seen his missing towel.

Kardashian proved she was fully in on the joke just a couple of weeks later. Ahead of the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix, she officially made amends by surprising Antonelli with a brand-new, custom-embroidered replacement towel, sparking a highly publicised "thank you" video from the young Mercedes driver.
While the red carpet interaction was all smiles and jokes, the actual Singapore Grand Prix yielded very different results for the drivers involved in Kardashian's F1 orbit.

Antonelli managed to survive the extreme heat, severe tyre degradation, and a major track limits controversy to secure a hard-fought third-place podium finish, keeping his massive championship lead intact. Meanwhile, Hamilton - whom Kardashian was actively cheering for from the Ferrari garage following a pre-race grid interview with Martin Brundle - suffered a late-race strategy blunder and a costly missed pit entry, plummeting him down the order to a deeply frustrating sixth-place finish.

With Antonelli mathematically on the verge of clinching the World Drivers' Championship at the upcoming United States Grand Prix in Austin, it remains to be seen if Kardashian will make the trip to Texas to ensure the young star's championship towels stay safe.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯技术总监警告，F1车队不会对2027年下压力削减坐视不管
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森警告，F1工程师将对国际汽联2027年的下压力削减予以反击
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
F1向2026年新动力单元与底盘规则的过渡彻底打乱了竞争格局，但规则手册远未最终确定。随着车队为2027年新规下的第二个赛季做准备，国际汽联正推动再次强制降低下压力。
早期报告表明，管理机构的目标是在2027赛季将下压力减少20至50个点。为了实现这一目标，国际汽联计划禁止若干关键的后部空气动力学部件，以改善混合动力能量管理，并减少阻碍赛车紧密跟车的湍流“脏空气”。
但梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森最近警告说，制定规则来减慢一级方程式赛车的速度，很少能阻止围场顶尖工程师找到绕过它的办法。
在NU Silver Arrows Radio Show播客节目中，艾利森确认了国际汽联拟议的空气动力学限制范围，同时向即将到来的研发战发出了挑战。
“我所知道的是，新规则会让赛车损失一些下压力，不止一点，”艾利森解释道。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯车队
从历史上看，国际汽联与一级方程式车队之间的关系始终是一场无休止的猫鼠游戏。管理机构出于安全和竞赛考量修改规则手册以限制过弯速度，而车队则立即在风洞中投入数百万美元，以恢复国际汽联试图削去的下压力。
据艾利森表示，2027年的规则周期也不会有任何不同。
“他们已经做出了不错的尝试，试图将下压力拉回到2026时代初期的水平，”艾利森指出。
他补充道：“看看各车队是会选择妥协接受，还是会全力夺回全部性能，这将非常有意思。”
如果梅赛德斯在2026年的巨大飞跃能说明什么，那就是阿利森在布拉克利的工程部门完全没有妥协的打算。2027赛季的技术战线已经正式划定。
detailEn: Mercedes technical director warns F1 teams won’t “lie down” over 2027 downforce cuts
Mercedes technical director James Allison warns F1 engineers will fight back against the FIA's 2027 downforce cuts
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Formula 1's transition to the new 2026 engine and chassis regulations completely reshuffled the competitive order, but the rulebook is far from finalised. As teams prepare for their second year under the new formula in 2027, the FIA is pushing to mandate another drop in downforce.

Early reports indicate the governing body is targeting a reduction of 20 to 50 points of downforce for the 2027 season. To achieve this, the FIA plans to ban several key rear aerodynamic elements in a bid to improve hybrid energy management and reduce the turbulent "dirty air" that prevents cars from following each other closely.
But Mercedes technical director James Allison recently cautioned that writing a rule to slow down a Formula 1 car rarely stops the grid's top engineers from finding a way around it.

Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show podcast, Allison confirmed the scope of the FIA's proposed aerodynamic restrictions while simultaneously throwing down the gauntlet for the upcoming development war.
"All I know is that the cars are going to be losing a bit of downforce from the new regs, more than a bit," Allison explained.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Historically, the relationship between the FIA and Formula 1 constructors is a perpetual game of cat and mouse. The governing body alters the rulebook to limit cornering speeds on safety and racing grounds, and the teams immediately spend millions of dollars in the wind tunnel to recover the exact downforce the FIA attempted to take away.
According to Allison, the 2027 regulation cycle will be no different.
"They've had a good go at trying to pull the downforce back to [the] start of the 2026 era," Allison noted.
"It'll be interesting to see whether the teams lie down and take that or whether we recover it all or not," he added.

If Mercedes' massive leap forward in 2026 is any indication, Allison's engineering department in Brackley has zero intention of lying down. The technical battle lines for the 2027 season have officially been drawn.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛上推出阿迪达斯系列
梅赛德斯-奔驰霓虹灯和奥迪夜场系列现已通过adidas.com购买
拉斯维加斯欢迎标志上空出现彩虹
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪为即将到来的Formula 1拉斯维加斯大奖赛推出了特别的阿迪达斯粉丝系列。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列名为"霓虹灯"，而奥迪的系列名为"深夜"。这两个系列现在已在adidas.com上上市，品牌美国店内的单品价格从30美元到200美元不等。
最贵的产品是外套。梅赛德斯-奔驰的拉斯维加斯夹克和奥迪的拉斯维加斯轰炸机夹克都售价200美元。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列比奥迪的大。除了夹克，它还包括120美元的卫衣、95美元的长袖T恤、60美元的短裤、55美元的车手帽、50美元的比赛帽和40美元及45美元的T恤。
奥迪车队的阵容有55美元的车手上限，两件各45美元的图形T恤和一件30美元的包。
两支车队抵达拉斯维加斯时的位置截然不同。梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛上锁定了2026年 constructors' championship。奥迪在接管萨博后作为一支工厂车队的第一赛季，目前排名第八，积28分。这家德国车队落后哈斯三分。
梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了车手冠军，成为F1历史上最年轻的冠军。他的队友乔治·拉塞尔目前正在争夺亚军，目前排名第三，落后红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和尼科·胡肯伯格目前在车手积分榜上分别排名第14和第15，两人都积14分。
拉斯维加斯大奖赛将于11月19日至21日举行，是赛季最后三轮比赛中的第一轮，紧接着是卡塔尔和阿布扎比。
detailEn: Mercedes and Audi unveil adidas collections for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
The Mercedes Neon Lights and Audi After Hours collections are available now through adidas.com
A rainbow above the Welcome to Las Vegas sign
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Mercedes and Audi have unveiled special adidas fan collections for the upcoming Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Mercedes' range is called "Neon Lights", while Audi's is named "After Hours". Both collections are available now through adidas.com, and the pieces listed on the brand's US store range in price from $30 to $200.
The most expensive items are the outerwear. Mercedes' Las Vegas jacket and Audi's Las Vegas bomber jacket both cost $200.
The Mercedes collection is the bigger of the two. Alongside the jacket, it includes a $120 hoodie, a $95 long-sleeve T-shirt, $60 shorts, a $55 driver cap, a $50 race cap and T-shirts at $40 and $45.
Audi's line-up has a $55 driver cap, two graphic T-shirts at $45 each and a $30 bag.

The two teams arrive in Las Vegas in very different positions. Mercedes secured the 2026 constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix. Audi, in its first season as a works team after taking over Sauber, currently sits eighth in the standings with 28 points. The German outfit is three points behind Haas.

Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed the drivers' title at the Mexican Grand Prix, becoming the youngest champion in the history of F1. His team-mate George Russell is currently in the fight for second in the championship, sitting third behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto and Nico Hulkenberg currently sit 14th and 15th in the drivers' standings, both on 14 points.
The Las Vegas Grand Prix takes place from 19 to 21 November and is the first of the final three rounds of the season, ahead of Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与荷兰技术集团VDK签任大使协议
这位红牛车手将在未来数年参与VDK的传播与营销活动
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘成为荷兰安装与技术企业集团VDK Group的新任大使，该集团正在向欧洲扩张。
这位荷兰车手将在未来几年在该公司的国际品牌推广中发挥重要作用，并将出现在其传播和营销活动中。
VDK 成立于 2013 年，是一家荷兰技术公司集团，如今在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时都有业务。
维斯塔潘表示，他认为 VDK 的组织方式与 F1 车队的运作方式有相似之处。
“VDK 的世界与一级方程式赛车之间有很多相似之处，”这位红牛车手说道。“技术发挥着巨大作用，但任何关注这项运动的人都知道，只有整个团队都达到顶尖水平，你才能发挥出最佳表现。”
在一支一级方程式车队里，每天都有大量的人在工作，让一切变得更好、更快。每个人都有自己的专业领域和职责。我在VDK的运作方式中看到了这一点。
它由许多技术公司和专业人士组成，他们各有专长，但团结在一起就更强大。VDK是一家创新型公司，也有着远大的国际雄心。我很高兴能在未来几年成为其中一员。
VDK创始人兼首席执行官弗兰斯·范德科尔克表示，这位荷兰人是公司下一步发展的理想人选。
“马克斯·维斯塔潘加入VDK集团让我无比自豪，”范德科尔克说。“马克斯多年来一直是世界上最顶尖的车手之一。但同样吸引我的是这背后的一切。仅靠天赋永远不够。你需要身边有优秀的人、相互信任、技术专长，以及每天变得更好的动力。这正是我在VDK集团所看到的。”
“我们通过整合实力雄厚的本地家族企业，并给予创业者自由发展的空间来实现增长。这一基础不会改变。与此同时，我们正日益将目光投向国门之外。”
“随着在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时拥有公司，我们正在形成一个日益国际化的集团。马克斯·维斯塔潘闻名世界，同时也体现了那种令人熟悉的荷兰务实态度和赢家心态。说实话，我无法想象还有谁比他更能代表我们希望带领VDK前进的方向。”
过去两年一直与VDK合作的前F1车手罗伯特·杜恩博斯将继续担任大使和演讲嘉宾。根据公告，他在协调与维斯塔潘的合作关系中发挥了关键作用。
“我非常高兴能与弗兰斯和VDK集团合作，”杜恩博斯解释道。“我们已经共同取得了伟大的成就，我也真正了解了VDK背后的人。如今我还能为这一下一步贡献力量，这让一切更加特别。”
“有了马克斯，VDK 集团当然就引进了一位真正独一档的人物。我很高兴我们现在为 VDK 集团携手合作，也非常期待未来的岁月。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
The Red Bull driver will feature in VDK’s communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies that is expanding across Europe.
The Dutchman will play a prominent role in the company's international branding over the coming years and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns.
VDK was founded in 2013 as a Dutch group of technical companies and now has businesses in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland and Belgium.
Verstappen said he saw parallels between the way VDK is organised and the way an F1 team works.

"There are many similarities between the world of VDK and Formula 1," the Red Bull driver said. "Technology plays a huge role, but anyone who follows the sport knows that you can only perform at your best if the entire team is top-notch.

"In a Formula 1 team, a huge number of people work every day to make everything better and faster. Everyone has their own area of specialisation and responsibility. I recognise that in the way VDK operates.

"It’s a group of many technical companies and professionals who all have their own expertise but are stronger together. VDK is an innovative company and also has major international ambitions. I’m excited to be a part of that in the coming years."
VDK founder and chief executive Frans van der Kolk said the Dutchman was the ideal fit for the company's next step.

"The fact that Max Verstappen is joining the VDK Group makes me incredibly proud," van der Kolk said. "Max has been among the absolute world’s best for years. But what appeals to me just as much is what lies behind that. Talent alone is never enough. You need good people around you, mutual trust, technical expertise, and the drive to get better every day. That’s exactly what I see in the VDK Group.

"We’ve grown by bringing together strong local and family-owned businesses and giving entrepreneurs the freedom to thrive. That foundation won’t change. At the same time, we’re looking beyond our borders with increasing focus.

"With companies in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland, and Belgium, we’re forming an increasingly international group. Max Verstappen is known worldwide and, at the same time, embodies that recognisable Dutch down-to-earth attitude and winner’s mentality. To be honest, I can’t imagine a stronger face to represent where we want to take VDK."

Former F1 driver Robert Doornbos, who has worked with VDK for the past two years, will stay on as an ambassador and speaker. According to the announcement, he played a key role in coordinating the partnership with Verstappen.

"I am very pleased with the collaboration with Frans and the VDK Group," Doornbos explained. "We’ve already achieved great things together, and I’ve really gotten to know the people behind VDK. The fact that I’ve now also been able to contribute to this next step makes it even more special.

"With Max, the VDK Group is, of course, bringing in someone who is truly in a league of his own. I’m happy that we’re now working together for the VDK Group and am really looking forward to the years ahead."
